privacy: Local files only. Your document stays in this browser.
drop: Drop a PowerPoint presentation, slideshow, or template here to convert
invalid: Choose a readable PPTX, PPTM, POTX, POTM, PPSX, or PPSM file. The presentation may be damaged or use an unsupported feature.
protected: Encrypted presentations and legacy PowerPoint files cannot be converted. Save an unencrypted PPTX copy and try again.
resource: This document needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The converter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
noText: This presentation has no extractable text. Images are not transcribed.
copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Select it in the output or download the Markdown file.
formatNote: Markdown keeps text and basic structure, not slide layout. Slides remain in file order; hidden slides are included and marked. Speaker notes follow their slides.
omittedNote: Images, charts, equations, media, and embedded objects use omission markers. Template decorations, review comments, animations, and transitions are not exported. Merged tables and complex formatting are simplified; check the output against the original.
